theme: 자판기 앞에서 어려움을 겪는 Dave를 도와준 한 학생의 친절

overview.theme_ko: 자판기 앞 Dave를 도와준 학생의 친절
overview.topic: 🔎 소외된 Dave를 자판기 앞에서 도운 한 상급생의 작은 친절
overview.stance_reason: for one moment, they'd shared a real understanding
overview.structure_reason: on that afternoon → After he failed → Just then → After that → Then → that day 로 사건이 시간 순서대로 이어진다

key_grammar.point: 과거완료(had+p.p.): 이야기 흐름에서 한 시점보다 '더 이전'에 일어난 일
key_grammar.source_sentence: I saw him turn to sit down, looking like he had given up.

explanation.text: [[과거완료]](had+p.p.)는 과거의 어느 시점보다 '더 먼저' 일어난 일을 나타낸다
본 시점 saw 보다 먼저 일어난 '[[포기]]'를 had given up 으로 표현했다
단순과거는 사건의 순서를, 과거완료는 '[[대과거]]'(더 이전)를 강조한다

key_grammar.example_analysis: 'had given up'은 본 시점(saw)보다 더 이전의 '이미 포기한' 상태를 나타내는 과거완료다.

drills.question: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? 'I saw him turn to sit down, looking like he ___ up.'
빈칸에 알맞은 것은? 'just as the dollar ___ a place in a warm-hearted senior's pocket'
그가 몇 번 실패한 후, 몇몇 학생들이 그를 비웃기 시작했다.
drills.answer: After he failed a few times, some students began to laugh at him.

drills.question: 그녀가 이미 떠난 뒤였기 때문에 나는 그녀를 볼 수 없었다.
drills.answer: I couldn't see her because she had already left.

restatement_chains.label: 소외·거리감
restatement_chains.variation: Dave가 또래 집단에서 떨어져 있는 상태를 여러 표현으로 반복한다

restatement_chains.label: 친절과 받아들여짐
restatement_chains.variation: 한순간의 이해와 따뜻함, 그리고 '자리를 찾음'으로 주제가 이어진다

flow_blocks.summary: 붐비는 식당 속에서 또래와 [[동떨어진]] 채 목말라하는 Dave
flow_blocks.easy_example: 교실 구석에 혼자 앉아 있는 전학생을 떠올려 보라
카드가 자꾸 안 찍혀 뒷사람 눈치를 보는 상황
될 때까지 다시 해 보겠다고 마음먹는 순간

flow_blocks.easy_example: 말 한마디 없이도 통했다고 느끼는 짧은 순간

flow_blocks.easy_example: 구겨진 지폐도 결국 누군가의 주머니에 담기듯

sentences.english: While the cafeteria was full of high school students on that afternoon, Dave was thirsty.

chunks.en: of high school [[students]] on that afternoon,

misreads.statement: 식당이 붐빈 것은 Dave 때문이었다.
misreads.anchor: the cafeteria was full of high school students
misreads.why: 식당을 가득 채운 것은 고등학생들이며 Dave와는 무관하다.

mistips: 'While ~'을 '잠깐'으로 읽으면 안 돼 — 여기선 '[[~하는 동안]]'의 대조 접속사

sentences.english: We sat near yet away from him, fixing our hair and worrying about the test next period we hadn't studied for.

grammar.note: had p.p. — 시험 전에 공부 안 한 상태

chunks.en: We sat near yet [[away]] from him,
and [[worrying]] about the test next period

misreads.statement: him은 화자 자신들(We)을 가리킨다.
misreads.why: him은 화자들과 떨어져 앉은 Dave를 가리키며 We가 아니다.

sentences.english: He was far away from our world, yet forced to be a part of it.

chunks.en: He was far away from our [[world]],
yet [[forced]] to be a part of it.

misreads.statement: 그는 우리 세계에서 멀리 떨어져 있어서 그 세계와 아무 상관이 없었다.
misreads.anchor: forced to be a part of it
misreads.why: '멀리 떨어져 있다'는 방향은 맞지만, 억지로 그 '일부가 되어야' 했다.

sentences.english: He stood at the drink machine with purpose, fumbling through his fake leather wallet for some change.

chunks.en: He stood at the drink machine with [[purpose]],
chunks.ko: 그는 [[목적]]을 가지고 음료 자판기 앞에 섰고,

misreads.statement: Dave는 목적을 갖고 자판기 앞에 서서 지갑에서 잔돈을 더듬어 찾았다.

sentences.english: He came up with a wrinkled dollar bill, and nervously glanced back at his table where other students in his class were sitting.

chunks.en: He came up with a [[wrinkled]] dollar bill,
and [[nervously]] glanced back at his table
where other [[students]] in his class were sitting.
chunks.ko: 그곳에는 그의 반 다른 [[학생들]]이 앉아 있었다.

misreads.statement: his table의 his와 his class의 his는 서로 다른 사람을 가리킨다.
misreads.anchor: his table where other students in his class
misreads.why: 두 his는 모두 Dave를 가리키므로 같은 사람이다.

sentences.english: Dave tried to make the machine accept his money.

misreads.statement: Dave는 자판기가 자신의 돈을 받아들이게 하려고 애썼다.

sentences.english: After he failed a few times, some students began to laugh at him.

chunks.en: some students began to [[laugh]] at him.

misreads.statement: 학생들이 비웃었기 때문에 Dave가 실패했다.
misreads.anchor: After he failed a few times, some students began to laugh
misreads.why: Dave의 실패가 먼저이고 비웃음은 그 뒤에 일어난 결과다.

sentences.english: He started shaking, and tears began to form in his eyes.

chunks.en: and [[tears]] began to form in his eyes.

misreads.statement: 눈물이 맺히기 시작한 것은 그를 비웃던 학생들이다.
misreads.anchor: tears began to form in his eyes
misreads.why: 눈물이 맺힌 것은 his eyes, 즉 Dave이지 학생들이 아니다.

sentences.english: I saw him turn to sit down, looking like he had given up.

chunks.en: I saw him [[turn]] to sit down,

misreads.statement: 화자는 Dave가 실제로 완전히 포기했다고 단정한다.
misreads.anchor: looking like he had given up
misreads.why: '포기한 것처럼 보였다'는 인상일 뿐 단정한 것이 아니다.

sentences.english: But for some reason, he decided against it.

chunks.en: But for some reason, he [[decided]] against it.
chunks.ko: 하지만 무슨 이유에서인지, 그는 그러지 않기로 [[결정]]했다.

misreads.statement: it은 Dave가 마시려던 음료를 가리킨다.
misreads.why: it은 앞에 나온 '앉아서 포기하려던 행동'을 가리킨다.

mistips: 'decided against it'을 '그것에 맞서 싸웠다'로 읽으면 안 돼 — '[[그렇게 하지 않기로]] 했다'는 뜻

sentences.english: He wasn't leaving until he got a drink.

misreads.statement: 그는 음료를 손에 넣기 전까지는 그 자리를 떠나려 하지 않았다.

sentences.english: With a determined expression, he kept aimlessly pushing the dollar bill into the machine.

chunks.en: he kept [[aimlessly]] pushing the dollar bill
chunks.ko: 그는 계속 [[아무렇게나]] 달러 지폐를 밀어 넣었고

misreads.statement: 그는 화가 나서 자판기를 발로 차기 시작했다.
misreads.anchor: he kept aimlessly pushing the dollar bill
misreads.why: 그는 지폐를 계속 밀어 넣었을 뿐, 자판기를 찼다는 내용은 없다.

sentences.english: Just then a popular senior boy stood up from his seat, and walked over to the boy.

chunks.en: Just then a popular [[senior]] boy stood up from his seat,
chunks.ko: 바로 그때 인기 많은 [[상급생]]이 자리에서 일어섰고,

misreads.statement: 인기 많은 상급생이 자리에서 일어나 Dave에게 다가갔다.

sentences.english: He calmly explained how the machine often had trouble accepting dollar bills.

spans: how the machine often had trouble

misreads.statement: 여기서 He는 설명을 들은 Dave를 가리킨다.
misreads.why: 설명한 He는 앞 문장에서 다가온 상급생을 가리킨다.

sentences.english: After that, he pulled some coins from his pocket and put them into the machine.

chunks.en: After that, he pulled some [[coins]] from his pocket

misreads.statement: 주머니에서 동전을 꺼낸 사람은 Dave다.
misreads.anchor: he pulled some coins from his pocket
misreads.why: 동전을 꺼낸 he는 도와준 상급생이며 Dave가 아니다.

sentences.english: Dave gave him his dollar and chose a flavor of fruit juice.

chunks.en: and chose a [[flavor]] of fruit juice.

misreads.statement: Dave는 자신의 달러를 상급생에게 건네고 과일 주스 맛을 골랐다.

sentences.english: Then the two walked off in different directions.

misreads.statement: The two boys kept talking and left together.
misreads.why: 둘은 서로 '다른' 방향으로 떠났고 함께 가지 않았다.

sentences.english: Although it was clear that they were from very different worlds, for one moment, they'd shared a real understanding.

grammar.note: had shared — 그 이전에 나눈 이해

chunks.en: that they were from very different [[worlds]],
for one moment, they'd [[shared]] a real understanding.

misreads.statement: 화자는 둘이 서로 다른 세계 출신이라 끝내 서로를 이해하지 못했다고 본다.
misreads.why: '다른 세계'라는 판단은 맞지만, 한순간 '진정한 이해를 나눴다'고 했다.

sentences.english: As I walked away from my lunch table that day, I looked at Dave.

chunks.en: As I [[walked]] away from my lunch table that day,

misreads.statement: 그날 점심 자리를 떠난 사람은 Dave다.
misreads.anchor: As I walked away from my lunch table
misreads.why: 자리를 떠난 것은 화자(I)이고 Dave가 아니다.

sentences.english: I thought he and the dollar were very much alike.

spans: thought he and the dollar were

chunks.en: he and the dollar were very much [[alike]].

misreads.statement: 화자는 Dave와 그 달러가 서로 완전히 다르다고 생각했다.
misreads.anchor: he and the dollar were very much alike

sentences.english: They both weren't accepted where the world said they were supposed to be.

chunks.en: where the [[world]] said they were supposed to be.

misreads.statement: 세상이 그들에게 있으라고 정해 준 곳에서 그들은 잘 받아들여졌다.
misreads.anchor: weren't accepted where the world said they were supposed to be

sentences.english: But just as the dollar had found a place in a warm-hearted senior's pocket, I was sure he would eventually find his, too.

grammar.note: had found — 확신 이전에 자리를 찾음

chunks.en: But just as the dollar had [[found]] a place
I was sure he would [[eventually]] find his, too.
chunks.ko: 나는 그도 [[결국]] 자신의 자리를 찾을 것이라고 확신했다.

misreads.statement: 달러가 상급생의 주머니에서 자리를 찾았듯, 화자는 Dave도 결국 자기 자리를 찾으리라 확신했다.
